thread:
anya: FYI seeing weird provisional token totals in invoice preview during alias fallback canary. Example: call routed from model-alias `rico-v1` -> fallback `rico-v1-quant` shows both token lines in preview. Anyone on billing/metering oncall?

devon: I can repro on staging. The route resolver emits both route tags, and proxy creates a separate req_id for fallback attempts. Our downstream metering aggregates by req_id so fallback generates a separate event instead of updating the original.

maria: Short term: add two fields at ingress before fallback happens: canonical_req_id and canonical_model_alias. Aggregator/billing can dedupe on canonical_req_id when present.

liam: Schema change will ripple. Some legacy joins expect req_id as the single linkage key. We need a consumer opt-in flag so old consumers don't break. Also event size increase may matter for hot topics.

ops-eng: Another approach w/o producer changes: collision-detect in the aggregator using a small fingerprint (tenant_id + session_id + prompt_prefix_hash) and a 1s coalescing window. If fingerprint matches, merge token counts and pick winner model tag. That avoids schema churn.

anya: Which is lower risk for canary mitigation?

devon: Low-risk immediate: emit canonical fields for a tiny sample (2%) so we can verify dedupe works end-to-end without flipping consumers. Parallel: add fingerprint-based coalescer as a safety net; will require careful perf testing.

maria: example event we can emit from edge (pseudocode):

```json
{
  "req_id": "r_01XyZ",
  "canonical_req_id": "r_01XyZ_orig",
  "model_alias": "rico-v1",
  "canonical_model_alias": "rico-v1-quant",
  "tenant_id": "org_77",
  "token_delta": 124
}
```

liam: add a consumer feature flag like prefers_canonical_id in the consumer config. Billing joins should switch over behind the flag; then we can flip it org-by-org.

ops-eng: Console UX request: mark preview invoices clearly as "Provisional (can include duplicates)" and show a short tooltip: "Preview is provisional during routing rollouts; final invoice will reflect deduped counts." Also add a small banner when preview_diff > threshold.

anya: good. Let's also add a few telemetry signals: billing.preview_dup_rate (fraction of preview tokens deduped), billing.preview_delta_tokens, and a simple alert if preview_dup_rate > 0.2% for 15m.

devon: canary plan: start emitting canonical fields for 2% of traffic for 30min. Measure preview_dup_rate and invoice_preview_delta. If <0.1% we expand to 25% then 100%. Also enable aggregator dedupe counter metric so we know dedupe events per minute.

billing-bot: NOTE: created billing ticket BL-404 to track downstream migration and reconciliation scripts.

maria: opening PR with schema + consumer opt-in flag and migration notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9123

anya: thanks all. tagging @billing-team @console-ux for visibility. We'll avoid sending preview emails while this is in high-visibility canary. :eyes:
